subject: Curriculum Review and Assessment Process
overview: The subcommittee met with district administration and curriculum leaders to review the status of district curricula under the strategic plan and discuss developing an ongoing curriculum review and assessment process. No formal votes were taken.

items.title: Curriculum Review Process and Strategic Plan Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Suzanne Galusi and department leaders presented an update on curriculum implementations across disciplines and discussed using NWEA MAP assessments, internal benchmarks, and cross-departmental standards to monitor curriculum fidelity and effectiveness.
